disclaimer: Move within a comfortable range. Stop for sharp pain, dizziness, numbness, or loss of balance. Seek qualified professional guidance when appropriate.

items.name: Tree Pose
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Stand tall and shift weight into one foot. Place the other foot below or above the knee, never on the knee joint. Choose a steady gaze and breathe evenly.
items.breath: Breathe slowly while keeping the standing leg active.
items.safety: Use a wall for balance if needed.

items.name: Downward-Facing Dog
items.hold: Hold 25 sec
items.steps: Begin on hands and knees. Lift the hips up and back. Keep the knees softly bent if needed and lengthen the spine.
items.breath: Exhale as the hips move back.
items.safety: Reduce wrist loading or skip if it causes pain.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.hold: Hold 45 sec
items.steps: Kneel and bring the hips toward the heels. Reach forward or rest the arms comfortably. Let the head be supported if it does not reach the floor.
items.breath: Let each exhale soften the torso.
items.safety: Widen the knees or add support if the hips or knees feel compressed.

items.name: Warrior II
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Step the feet wide and turn the front toes outward. Bend the front knee toward the toes. Reach both arms long and gaze over the front hand.
items.breath: Keep the breath steady as the legs work.
items.safety: Shorten the stance if the knee or hip feels strained.

items.name: Seated Forward Fold
items.hold: Hold 25 sec
items.steps: Sit tall with the legs extended or knees softly bent. Hinge forward from the hips. Rest the hands wherever they reach without pulling.
items.breath: Lengthen on the inhale and soften on the exhale.
items.safety: Avoid rounding or forcing the lower back.

items.name: Mountain Pose
items.hold: Hold 30 sec
items.steps: Stand with feet grounded and knees unlocked. Lengthen through the crown of the head. Relax the shoulders and let the arms rest.
items.breath: Take slow, even breaths through the nose.
items.safety: Stand near support if balance is uncertain.

items.name: Cobra Pose
items.hold: Hold 15 sec
items.steps: Lie on the belly with hands beside the ribs. Press the feet down and lift the chest gently. Keep the elbows bent and shoulders away from the ears.
items.breath: Inhale as the chest lifts.
items.safety: Keep the lift small and stop if the lower back pinches.

items.name: Bridge Pose
items.hold: Hold 20 sec
items.steps: Lie down with knees bent and feet planted. Press through the feet and lift the hips. Keep the knees tracking forward and lower slowly.
items.breath: Exhale to lift and inhale to lower with control.
items.safety: Keep the neck neutral and do not turn the head while lifted.

items.name: Low Lunge
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Step one foot forward from kneeling. Stack the front knee over the ankle. Gently shift forward while keeping the torso tall.
items.breath: Breathe into the front of the back hip.
items.safety: Pad the back knee and reduce depth as needed.

items.name: Triangle Pose
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Stand wide and turn the front foot outward. Reach forward and place the lower hand lightly on the leg or a block. Extend the upper arm and keep both sides of the torso long.
items.breath: Breathe into the open side ribs.
items.safety: Look down or forward if looking up affects balance or the neck.

items.name: Easy Pose
items.hold: Hold 1 min
items.steps: Sit cross-legged on the floor or a cushion. Let the pelvis feel level and the spine tall. Rest the hands and soften the face.
items.breath: Let the breath become quiet and unforced.
items.safety: Elevate the hips or sit in a chair if needed.

items.name: Corpse Pose
items.hold: Hold 3 min
items.steps: Lie comfortably on the back. Let the feet and hands relax outward. Support the knees or head if that improves comfort.
items.breath: Allow the breath to return to its natural rhythm.
items.safety: Choose side-lying or another comfortable rest position if preferred.

items.name: Cat Pose
items.hold: 5 slow reps
items.steps: Begin on hands and knees. Press the floor away and round the spine. Let the head follow without forcing the neck.
items.breath: Exhale as the spine rounds.
items.safety: Use padding and reduce wrist pressure as needed.

items.name: Cow Pose
items.hold: 5 slow reps
items.steps: Begin on hands and knees. Tip the pelvis and broaden the chest forward. Keep the backbend smooth and comfortable.
items.breath: Inhale as the chest opens.
items.safety: Avoid collapsing into the lower back or neck.

items.name: Warrior I
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Step one foot back and ground it comfortably. Bend the front knee and square the torso forward as available. Reach the arms overhead without lifting the shoulders.
items.breath: Stay tall through steady breaths.
items.safety: Use a shorter stance or keep hands at the hips for balance.

items.name: Chair Pose
items.hold: Hold 20 sec
items.steps: Stand tall and sit the hips back. Keep weight balanced through the feet. Reach forward or overhead while the spine stays long.
items.breath: Breathe steadily without gripping the jaw.
items.safety: Keep the range shallow if the knees feel uncomfortable.

items.name: Garland Pose
items.hold: Hold 25 sec
items.steps: Stand with a comfortable wide stance. Lower into a squat only as far as control allows. Keep the chest lifted and use support if needed.
items.breath: Use slow breaths to relax unnecessary tension.
items.safety: Sit on a block or hold support if depth or balance is limited.

items.name: Seated Spinal Twist
items.hold: 20 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Sit tall in a comfortable position. Rotate from the rib cage without pulling aggressively. Keep both sitting bones grounded as available.
items.breath: Lengthen on the inhale and rotate gently on the exhale.
items.safety: Keep the twist small if the back is sensitive.

items.name: Bound Angle Pose
items.hold: Hold 40 sec
items.steps: Sit with the soles of the feet together. Let the knees relax outward without pressing them. Sit tall or hinge slightly forward from the hips.
items.breath: Breathe softly into the hips and lower ribs.
items.safety: Support the thighs with cushions if needed.

items.name: Legs Up the Wall
items.hold: Hold 3 min
items.steps: Sit beside a wall and carefully roll onto the back. Rest the legs up the wall without forcing them straight. Settle the arms and shoulders comfortably.
items.breath: Let the exhale become longer and softer.
items.safety: Exit slowly; skip inversions if a clinician has advised against them.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
items.hold: 6 slow reps per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Sit with knees bent and feet wider than the hips. Lower both knees toward one side without forcing. Return through center and repeat to the other side.
items.breath: Exhale as the knees rotate.
items.safety: Use hands behind you for support.

items.name: Open Book Rotation
items.hold: 6 slow reps per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Lie on one side with knees comfortably bent. Reach the top arm across and open it toward the other side. Follow the hand only as far as the ribs move comfortably.
items.breath: Exhale into the opening phase.
items.safety: Keep the knees supported and stop if the shoulder pinches.

items.name: Ankle Rocks
items.hold: 8 slow reps per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Use a split stance near support. Keep the front heel down and guide the knee forward over the toes. Rock back and repeat smoothly.
items.breath: Keep breathing naturally through the movement.
items.safety: Stay pain-free and do not let the arch collapse.

items.name: Shoulder CAR
items.hold: 3 slow reps per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Stand tall and keep the ribs quiet. Circle one arm slowly through the largest pain-free range. Reverse with control.
items.breath: Breathe steadily; do not rush the circle.
items.safety: Make the circle smaller if there is pinching or compensation.

items.name: Hip CAR
items.hold: 3 slow reps per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Stand near support and brace gently. Lift one knee and trace a controlled circle from the hip. Keep the pelvis as still as possible.
items.breath: Use quiet breaths while moving slowly.
items.safety: Hold stable support and use a small pain-free range.

items.name: Wrist Flexion and Extension
items.hold: 8 slow reps
items.steps: Hold the forearms comfortably in front of you. Move the wrists slowly up and down. Keep the fingers relaxed and the motion controlled.
items.breath: Breathe naturally and keep the shoulders relaxed.
items.safety: Use a smaller range if tingling or pain appears.

items.name: Neck Rotation
items.hold: 5 slow reps per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders. Turn the head slowly toward one side. Return to center and repeat without forcing.
items.breath: Exhale gently into each turn.
items.safety: Stop for dizziness, radiating symptoms, or sharp pain.

items.name: Deep Squat Pry
items.hold: Hold 30 sec
items.steps: Take a comfortable wide stance and lower with control. Use support or sit on a block if needed. Shift gently side to side without forcing depth.
items.breath: Keep the breath slow while exploring the range.
items.safety: Use sturdy support and remain within a stable, pain-free depth.

items.name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Stand near support and bend one knee. Hold the ankle or use a strap without pulling hard. Keep the knees near each other and the pelvis neutral.
items.breath: Breathe slowly and keep the standing leg soft.
items.safety: Do not force the heel toward the body; use a strap if needed.

items.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Kneel with one foot forward and pad the back knee. Gently tuck the pelvis. Shift forward slightly while keeping the torso tall.
items.breath: Exhale while softening the front of the back hip.
items.safety: Avoid an exaggerated lower-back arch.

items.name: Supine Figure Four
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Lie on the back with knees bent. Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh. Draw the legs in only until a comfortable stretch is felt.
items.breath: Keep the face and shoulders relaxed.
items.safety: Keep the crossed foot gently flexed and do not press the knee.

items.name: Wall Calf Stretch
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Place both hands on a wall and step one foot back. Keep the back heel grounded and toes forward. Lean forward gently while the back knee stays comfortable.
items.breath: Breathe steadily without bouncing.
items.safety: Reduce the stance if the ankle or Achilles feels strained.

items.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
items.hold: Hold 25 sec
items.steps: Place the forearms lightly on a doorway. Step forward a small amount. Keep the ribs controlled and shoulders down.
items.breath: Inhale into the chest without forcing the range.
items.safety: Lower the arms or stop if the shoulder pinches.

items.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Bring one arm across the chest. Support it above the elbow with the other arm. Keep the shoulder down and avoid twisting.
items.breath: Exhale and relax the working shoulder.
items.safety: Do not pull on the elbow joint or force the arm.

items.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Raise one arm and bend the elbow behind the head. Use the other hand for light guidance above the elbow. Keep the ribs and neck relaxed.
items.breath: Breathe into the side ribs beneath the lifted arm.
items.safety: Do not force the shoulder or push the head forward.

items.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
items.hold: 25 sec per side · logs both sides
items.steps: Place one heel slightly forward with the toes gently lifted. Soften the back knee and send the hips backward. Keep a long neutral spine and rest the hands lightly on the upper thigh.
items.breath: Exhale as you hinge, without rounding or bouncing.
items.safety: Reduce the hinge if there is nerve-like pain or pulling behind the knee.
